summary: Montana resident, software developer with a focus on distributed systems, former high school math teacher, experience in insurance and financial advising, enjoys hiking, backpacking, cycling, fishing, and woodworking, strong interest in programming languages (Go, Python, Perl), advocates for educational reform and access to opportunities, family-oriented with a young family, values work-life balance, critical of insurance industry practices, engaged in personal development and fitness, enjoys reading science fiction and fantasy (Brandon Sanderson, Hyperion series), has a history of early parenthood, and emphasizes the importance of mentorship and networking in career growth.
